EP_00_train.speaker: narrator
EP_00_train.text: A train made of morning light pulls up at the edge of the Crossing. The sign on the front says BANDAR SENJA.

EP_01_morning.speaker: narrator
EP_01_morning.text: Bandar Senja Station, the morning after. 1963. A brand-new line opens today, and the first train of the day is due.

EP_01_morning.speaker: narrator
EP_01_morning.text: The humans on the platform can't see the spirits. But they all agree the station feels crowded this morning, in a nice way.

EP_01_morning.speaker: lumi
EP_01_morning.text: Everyone came to see us off.

EP_01_morning.speaker: reno
EP_01_morning.text: See us off? Where are we going?

EP_01_morning.speaker: lumi
EP_01_morning.text: Wherever the next train goes, I think.

EP_01_morning.speaker: narrator
EP_01_morning.text: Say goodbye to your friends, then board the first train.

EP_human_stationmaster.speaker: stationmaster
EP_human_stationmaster.text: (polishing a brass bell) First train on the new line, and I've got goosebumps. Like the whole station's holding its breath. Good kind of holding.

EP_human_girl.speaker: moon_girl
EP_human_girl.text: (to nobody) Thank you for the door in the moon. I knew it was real.

EP_elias.speaker: elias
EP_elias.text: I'm going back to Bandar Kencana. The town wants a radio programme: "Things We Remembered Today". Every evening at seven. Spirits AND humans can tune in, if they know how to listen.

EP_elias.speaker: elias
EP_elias.text: You'll fall asleep by seven fifteen.

EP_elias.speaker: narrator
EP_elias.text: That's everyone. The first train is waiting.

EP_maris.speaker: maris
EP_maris.text: Hutan Seribu Bunga is blooming again. All thousand flowers. I'm going to plant a few here, too. Stations should have flowers.

EP_maris.speaker: maris
EP_maris.text: Flowers remember everything. That's the whole trouble with them. And the whole joy.

EP_maris.speaker: narrator
EP_maris.text: That's everyone. The first train is waiting.

EP_taro.speaker: taro
EP_taro.text: The carnival's coming back next month, and guess who's the new Ringmaster's assistant. Me! Officially honest! ...Mostly honest.

EP_taro.speaker: narrator
EP_taro.text: Taro pulls a paper bird from behind Reno's ear. It flies off down the line, ahead of the train.

EP_taro.speaker: narrator
EP_taro.text: That's everyone. The first train is waiting.

EP_galen.speaker: galen
EP_galen.text: I'll go back to my gate. I'll leave it open this time. Anyone who climbs the mountain can come and sit with me.

EP_galen.speaker: galen
EP_galen.text: It is very quiet up there. The good kind of quiet.

EP_galen.speaker: galen
EP_galen.text: No. The kind where you can hear birds.

EP_galen.speaker: narrator
EP_galen.text: That's everyone. The first train is waiting.

EP_keeper.speaker: keeper_ep
EP_keeper.text: (at the ticket booth, in a clean blue coat) Free tickets, today only. For crossings. Anyone who wants to visit, may.

EP_keeper.speaker: keeper_ep
EP_keeper.text: I'm going to be an Oathkeeper again. A proper one. The kind that keeps doors open and catches people, instead of locking everything.

EP_keeper.speaker: reno
EP_keeper.text: You'll be great at catching. You've got really long arms.

EP_keeper.speaker: keeper_ep
EP_keeper.text: ...Thank you, Reno. For the page. For all of it.

EP_keeper.speaker: narrator
EP_keeper.text: That's everyone. The first train is waiting.

EP_train_wait.speaker: narrator
EP_train_wait.text: The first train of tomorrow hums at the platform. It will wait. Trains in this world are patient.

EP_train_wait.speaker: lumi
EP_train_wait.text: Let's say goodbye to everyone first.

EP_02_board.speaker: narrator
EP_02_board.text: The guard blows a whistle. Only the spirits hear the second whistle, softer and higher, that answers it from somewhere on the other side.

EP_02_board.speaker: reno
EP_02_board.text: Lumi. Do you think Maya and Seri can see us?

EP_02_board.speaker: lumi
EP_02_board.text: Every Lantern Moon, remember? We'll visit.

EP_02_board.speaker: reno
EP_02_board.text: Every single one. ...Hey. Where does this train actually go?

EP_02_board.speaker: lumi
EP_02_board.text: I don't know. Somewhere neither of us has been.

EP_02_board.speaker: narrator
EP_02_board.text: Reno and Lumi climb aboard the first train of tomorrow. On the platform their friends wave: a radio, a flower, a juggler, a boulder, and a man in a blue coat. The humans wave too, at the train, without quite knowing why.

EP_02_board.speaker: narrator
EP_02_board.text: The train pulls out into the morning, between two worlds that have decided, together, to stay open.
